title: Right Turn Scan: Pedestrian and Bicyclist at the Corner
section: Section 7 · Right-of-Way Rules · Turning right; Pedestrians
intro: A person is crossing ahead. A bicyclist is continuing straight on your right.
watchCaption: Pedestrian ahead. Bicyclist on your right.
safeCaption: Both clear the turn. Scan again, then go.
unsafeCaption: Wait for the pedestrian and bicyclist to pass.
safeFeedback: You wait for both the person and bicyclist, check again, then turn right.

feedback.turn-on-green: Green did not clear your turn’s path. Wait for the person and the bicyclist.
feedback.watch-cars-only: The person cleared, but the bicyclist was still beside you. Check both paths before turning.
